paper_title: On the Houdré-Tetali Conjecture About an Isoperimetric Constant of Graphs
classifications: Theory of computation → Random walks and Markov chains
statement: We believe that the same analysis of φp (G) can be extended to other generalizations of Cheeger’s inequality in [15, 11], and also to the directed edge conductance using the recent notions of reweighted eigenvalues in [19, 12, 13, 14]. We leave it as an open question to find a counterexample where the transition matrix is the simple random walk matrix of a graph.
